offline_aggregation.limitation: Recorded SQL-oracle verdicts are preserved, not rerun against private fixture databases by this offline script

resource_and_network_limits: RSS, file-descriptor and handle maxima are observed sampling lower bounds, not exact interval peaks.
CPU maxima are process per-wave interval ratios; one-core and host-capacity denominators remain separate, not instantaneous or whole-host saturation.
Unavailable metrics remain null. Both endpoints are on the same host; SSH only schedules and collects evidence.
Socket bytes include HTTP headers/body; exclude TCP/IP/link overhead, retransmissions and physical NIC capacity.
Cache is uncontrolled; no cold/hot or steady-state claim. No continuous sixty-second constant-N assertion.
These results do not establish D1/D2, higher concurrency, ten-thousand/one-hundred-thousand-user capacity or a service-capacity ceiling.
